item.name: Lemon Stand
item.managerAutomation: Cash Register Automator removes the click loop
item.keyUpgrades: Juicer; Cup Stand; Street Flyers; 2x Stand Cash
item.resetNote: Normal stand upgrades reset after Evolution; investor and permanent multiplier progress make rebuying faster.
item.bestUse: Buy Juicer and automation early so the stand keeps earning while you unlock LemonDash.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Stand is the first cash source. It teaches the core loop: click, collect ground cash, buy yield upgrades, then automate the stand.

item.name: LemonDash
item.playStyle: Active delivery, then passive with manager
item.managerAutomation: LemonDash Manager automates deliveries after fee and speed upgrades matter
item.keyUpgrades: Delivery Fees; Vehicle Speed; Order Tier upgrades
item.resetNote: Normal delivery progress resets with the run, but later multipliers make the unlock quick to rebuild.
item.bestUse: Rush it after the stand is stable because delivery payouts can skip early grind.
item.cardSummary: LemonDash turns the stand business into delivery orders. It is the first major active income spike after the basic stand.

item.name: Lemon Depot
item.unlock: After the early stand and delivery route
item.managerAutomation: Depot Manager automates bulk sales after core multipliers are upgraded
item.keyUpgrades: Per-click income; Depot multipliers; Depot Roof; Depot Walls; Depot Lights
item.resetNote: Depot structures reset, and hidden button gates need to be rebuilt each run.
item.bestUse: Sweep the Depot after buying decorations because roof, wall, and light purchases can reveal major buttons.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Depot moves the run into bulk selling. It is also where hidden decoration gates can make players think progression stopped.

item.name: Lemon Trading
item.managerAutomation: Trading Manager automates basic buy and sell decisions once market rhythm is understood
item.resetNote: Open trading progress resets with the run; avoid large trades right before a reset.
item.bestUse: Use it as supplemental income until you understand price swings and can afford mistakes.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Trading adds a stock-market style loop. It can pay well, but bad timing can set a run back.

item.name: Lemon Labs
item.managerAutomation: Labs Manager automates research output when permanent upgrades are active
item.keyUpgrades: Permanent upgrades; 8x income boost; Time-skip boosts; Labs Equipment
item.resetNote: Permanent Labs upgrades are the ones to prioritize before a long reset route.
item.bestUse: Prioritize permanent upgrades because they improve every future rebuild.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Labs is the first source where reset planning becomes the point. Its permanent upgrades can matter more than short-term cash.

item.name: Lemon Robotics
item.managerAutomation: Robotics Manager improves late-game automation after Robotics upgrades are funded
item.keyUpgrades: Full automation; manager efficiency; Robotics scaling upgrades
item.resetNote: High Evolution multipliers can make Robotics a skip target before rebuilding lower tiers.
item.bestUse: Push it when rebuild speed is high enough that automation beats step-by-step lower-tier grinding.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Robotics turns the run toward heavy automation. In high-Evolution play, it can become a priority target after a reset.

item.name: Lemon Republic
item.managerAutomation: Focused on global scaling instead of a separate manager
item.keyUpgrades: Central Bank; political upgrades; sovereignty multipliers
item.resetNote: Republic value scales hard with Ascend and Evolution multipliers, but normal source progress still belongs to the run.
item.bestUse: Use it to amplify earlier sources before pushing toward Orange X.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Republic is the seventh source and shifts the business into global multiplier scaling.

item.name: Orange X
item.managerAutomation: Focused on cosmic scaling instead of a separate manager
item.keyUpgrades: Rocket build; Moon base; UFO Key zone; Ascension scaling
item.resetNote: Orange X/LemonX depends on deep Evolution and Ascension progress more than normal early-run upgrades.
item.bestUse: Treat it as the final long-term target after Republic and Ascension systems are established.
item.cardSummary: Orange X is the final income source. Some sources call it LemonX, but both names point to the space-tier endgame source.
